verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm whose core product is legal advisory services, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product. Its ancillary tools (the SCC and Term Sheet generators on Contract Express, and the Deal Room hosted externally on HighQ) are third-party hosted, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable offering that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
